text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Playful high-end stylized 3D dollhouse-inspired architectural scene, lemon-yellow spiral staircase and translucent aqua glass swimming pool, glossy white curved villa walls and empty sun loungers, polished resin-like material mixed with tactile linen, fresh clear daylight and soft caustics, original uplifting fantasy, no dolls or occupants.
